zh: 运行中那一行以前只会说模型在做哪一类事。现在两种状态说到具体的东西：调用在跑时写出它操作的文件（「正在读取 app.js」「正在编辑 notes.md」「正在写入 out.txt」，只取文件名，过长的名字截到 32 字），推理正文里出现英文进行时从句时把模型自己那句话写出来（「Checking the file is true」——从动词截到这一句的句末符号，超过 40 字截断，否定的句子与不是英文的推理都不取，取不到就回到「正在思考」）。这一行跟着宿主自己的发布走，调用刚开始跑就被读到，不再等下一次心跳；每种说法写上之后锁住 1 秒，锁一过写当时最新的状态，中间来过的那些不补演，因此状态换得再快这一行也只一秒换一次；被锁跨过去的调用说法例外，它会在锁一过先补上——一次读完的小文件调用仍然说得出文件名。说法比这一行放得下的宽度更长时，它在这个宽度上截断并画省略号，计时与徽标留在原处。
en: The running line used to name only the kind of work a turn was on. Two of its states now say something concrete: a call in flight names the file it works on ("Reading app.js", "Editing notes.md", "Writing out.txt" — the file's own name, cut past 32 characters), and reasoning carrying an English present-continuous clause hands the line the model's own words ("Checking the file is true" — from the participle to that clause's end, cut past 40 characters, a negated clause and reasoning in another language passed over, and "Thinking…" where there is none). The line follows the host's own publishes, so a call is read the moment it starts running instead of on the next tick; every wording written is locked for a second, and the pass that finds the lock run out writes the newest state of that moment — whatever came and went inside the second is passed over, so a turn that moves quickly still changes the line at most once a second. A call's own words are the one thing the lock does not pass over: a small file read inside the second is written as soon as the lock ends. Wording wider than the room this line has is cut with an ellipsis while the clock and the badge keep their places.
